title: A cone with L-translation-invariant mass measure has density invariant under w ↦ y + λw (y ∈ L)
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ, every S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n, ℝ^P := Euclid P), every integer multiplicity representation R of S (R : IMRep univ n, R.Represents S) and every linear subspace L ⊆ ℝ^P: if S is a cone (IsConeCurrent S) and R.measure((· + v)^{-1}(A)) = R.measure(A) for every v ∈ L and every Borel A, then for all y ∈ L, λ > 0, w ∈ ℝ^P and θ ∈ ℝ, HasMassDensity S w θ implies HasMassDensity S (y + λw) θ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (L : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), R.Represents S → IsConeCurrent S → (∀ v ∈ L, ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → R.measure ((fun x => x + v) ⁻¹' A) = R.measure A) → ∀ y ∈ L, ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ (w : Euclid P) (θ : ℝ), HasMassDensity S w θ → HasMassDensity S (y + lam • w) θ
